description.value: A 28-site BC Parks campground on the shore of One Island Lake in Northern BC, with potable water and washrooms in a calm lakeside setting. The gate closes outside the operating season, making this a summer-only stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website resolves to the official BC Parks page for One Island Lake Park, confirming the campground is real and open; however, the fetched content is almost entirely site-wide navigation with no park-specific amenity details visible. OSM tags supply capacity (30), fee=yes, and internet_access=no as supplementary context, but no amenity claims can be confirmed from the sparse website text. A notable discrepancy exists: the OSM operator is listed as a private logging company ('Two Horse Power Logging') with a personal hotmail address, yet the linked website is the official BC Parks government page, suggesting possible private operation under BC Parks jurisdiction.
concerns: OSM operator 'Two Horse Power Logging' and personal hotmail contact email (harryprosser@hotmail.com) are inconsistent with the official BC Parks government website URL — may be a privately operated campground under a BC Parks designation, or OSM data may be outdated.
Fetched website content is almost entirely navigation boilerplate; no park-specific amenity details were retrievable, leaving most amenity fields unverifiable.
No civic address recorded in OSM; location is in a remote northern BC area (lat 55.31, lon -120.28).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, fee-based campground listed under BC Parks with a confirmed government web presence; no evidence of closure or inaccessibility.
